    How ordering works

    You order first. We bake. You pick up.

    1. Pick your bread

      Choose your loaves and how many you want.

    2. Pick a pickup day

      Choose a day that is still open. Days past their order-by time show as closed.

    3. Come get it

      We bake for the orders we have. You pick up on your day.

    A small bakery that bakes to order

    Simply Risen is a sourdough microbakery. We make fresh sourdough bread, bagels, English muffins, cookies and muffins.

    You tell us what you want and when you will pick it up. Then we bake it.

    Baked by Kari Pennington.

        Questions before you order

        How far ahead do I order?

        Each pickup day has an order-by time. You will see it next to the day when you order.

        When do I pay?

        Payment is not taken on this page. Ask us how to pay when you order.

        Can I change or cancel my order?

        Tell us as soon as you can and we will sort it out with you.

        What about allergies?

        Tell us about any allergy when you order.

        Do you ship?

        No. Orders are for pickup.

        Can I order something that is not on the menu?

        Ask us. We will tell you if we can bake it.
